title: Position of Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 1-50)
subtopic: Position of Parts of Speech (236 Marks)

questions.question: Go and catch the falling star. Here the 'falling' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Adjective
Trick: Verb + ing যদি noun কে describe করে → Adjective
(falling star = কেমন star?)

questions.question: Please write to me at the above address. The word 'above' in this sentence is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation: Trick: noun এর আগে বসে noun কে describe করলে → Adjective

questions.question:
The up train is late. এখানে up শব্দটি ---
The <u>front</u> page has the most important stories. Here 'front' is used as ---[]
questions.explanation:
Trick: noun এর আগে extra meaning দিলে → Adjective
front page → front = Adjective
(কোন page? front page)

questions.question: A somewhat <u>afraid</u> soldier. The underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
Adjective (afraid)
afraid soldier → কেমন soldier?

questions.question: This mutton has too much <u>fat</u> on it.[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
much / little → এর পরে সাধারণত uncountable noun বসে

questions.question: The word, 'round' in the sentence, "Let's play another round", functions as ---[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
another + word → সাধারণত noun
(another book, another chance, another round)
Another এখানে Adjective এর পর  noun ই হবে।
এখানে round মানে একবার খেলা → জিনিস বোঝাচ্ছে → Noun

questions.question: He sleeps a sound <u>sleep</u>. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Sleep = Noun
Trick:
a + word → ৯০% ক্ষেত্রে noun
(a book, a car, a sleep)

questions.question: He sleeps a <u>sound</u> sleep.[]
questions.explanation:
Sound = Adjective
Trick:
Noun এর আগে বসে noun কে describe করলে → Adjective
 কেমন sleep? sound sleep

questions.question: This is the <u>go</u> of life. Here 'go' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Go = Noun
 Trick:
the + word + of → সাধারণত noun phrase

questions.question: I didn't lose, but yours was a better buy. In the sentence 'buy' is used as ---[]
questions.explanation:
Buy = Noun
 Trick:
a/an + adjective + word → noun হয়
(a good buy, a better buy)
এখানে buy মানে purchase item → জিনিস → Noun

questions.question: I bought a very beautiful golden ring. The word 'golden' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Golden = Adjective
Trick: Noun (ring) এর আগে বসে describe করছে → Adjective

questions.question:
<u>Patience</u> is a virtue.
<u>Honesty</u> is the best policy.
[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick: গুণ/ভাব বোঝালে → Noun (Abstract noun)

questions.question: Frailty thy name is woman. Here 'Frailty' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
Trick: -ty ending → সাধারণত Abstract noun
(frailty, honesty, purity)

questions.question: <u>Hearing</u> of the case will be next week. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Hearing = Noun
Trick: Verb + ing যদি subject হয় → Gerund → Noun

questions.question: Lovely comes here regularly. Here 'Lovely' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Lovely = Noun
 Trick: Subject position এ থাকলে → Noun
(এখানে Lovely একজন ব্যক্তির নাম )

questions.question: I am in process of collecting <u>material</u> for my story.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick: preposition (in) এর পরে → সাধারণত noun

questions.question: Painters study <u>art</u>. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick: Study (verb) এর object → noun

questions.question:
They told us a tale about a tail. The word 'tale' is a ---
I had a talk with him. Here 'talk' is a ---
She was a <u>beauty</u> in her youth.
Rina is a <u>beauty</u> of the class.[]
questions.explanation:
সবগুলো Noun
Trick:
a + word → noun
(a tale, a talk, a beauty)

questions.question:
This is the go of the world. Here 'go' is a/an ---
It is the <u>talk</u> of the campus.
He kept the <u>fast</u> for a week.[]
questions.explanation:
সবগুলো Noun
Trick:
the + word + of → noun
the go of, the talk of
a fast →verbal noun

questions.question: Where there is a will,there is a way. Here 'will' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
a + word → noun
(a will = ইচ্ছা)

questions.question:
I walked for a <u>while</u>.
The case resulted in an <u>acquittal</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
for + a + word → noun
an + word → noun
while (সময়) → noun
 acquittal (-al ending) → noun

questions.question: Educating girls contributes to an <u>increase</u> of wealth through its impact on economic development.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
Verb + ing যদি subject হয় → Gerund → Noun
Educating = Noun

questions.question: I don't require a second to take up my cause. Here 'second' is used as ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
a + word → noun
 second= সময়ের একক

questions.question: The doctor took the round in the hospital. Here 'round' is a/an -----[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
the + word → noun
 doctor’s round = পরিদর্শন

questions.question: This is the fashion of the day. Here 'fashion' is a ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
the + word + of → noun phrase

questions.question: She opted for the humanities. Here 'humanities' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
the + plural subject name → noun

questions.question: He is an <u>eyesore</u> to me.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
an + word → noun
eyesore =chokher Bali বোঝাচ্ছে

questions.question: She looked at him with -----.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
with + word → noun লাগে
-amusement (-ment ending) → noun

questions.question: What is the (deep) of the canal ?[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
deep (adj) → depth (noun form)
-th ending → noun
The depth of -verbal noun

questions.question: Unless protected areas are established the Royal Bengal Tigers will face ----- of extinction.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
the + noun → correct
possibility একা বসালে article দরকার 
verbal noun

questions.question: Bangladesh has a good ----- in cricket.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
Trick:
a good (adj) + noun লাগে

questions.question: Honesty is the best <u>policy</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
Trick:
 quality → abstract noun
best (adj) এর পর noun

questions.question:
It is our <u>central</u> library.
His <u>total</u> score was 145 runs.[]
questions.explanation:
Adjective
 Trick:
noun এর আগে বসে → adjective
central library

questions.question:
We shall not see his look again. Here 'look' is a/an ---
His <u>responsibility</u> is questionable.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
his (possessive adj) + word → noun
 his look

questions.question: Her success was shattered by her later <u>commentary</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
-her commentary
possessive adj(her) এর পরে → noun

questions.question: This is my <u>village</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Noun
 Trick:
my (possessive adj) + word → noun
(village = স্থান)

questions.question: Try your <u>best</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
your (possessive adj) + word → noun
best এখানে “সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা” → জিনিস বোঝাচ্ছে

questions.question: I have received my <u>admit</u> card.[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
admit এখানে card কে modify করছে
admit card = fixed noun phrase
(admit = noun adjective / attributive noun)
Adj+noun

questions.question: I left my bag in this <u>morning</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
this (possessive adj)+ noun → noun phrase
morning = সময় → noun

questions.question: Find out the <u>text</u> in your <u>text</u> book. The underlined words are respectively :[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
text book → book কে modify করছে → text = adjective
book = noun
The text in -verbal noun

questions.question: Meaningful separation of <u>judiciary</u> is needed for the country.[]
questions.explanation: preposition (of) এর পর noun

questions.question: The matter was left in <u>abeyance</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
ending-ance- noun 
in (prep) + word → noun লাগে

questions.question:
There is some cause for concern but no need for alarm.
In the sentence 'concern' is ---[]
questions.explanation: for (preposition) + word → noun

questions.question: Tossing their heads in <u>sprightly</u> dance.[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
noun (dance) এর আগে describe করলে → adjective

questions.question:
Handle with <u>care</u>.
It needs to be done with <u>care</u>.[]
questions.explanation: with(preposition) + noun লাগে

questions.question: We have rights and <u>responsibilities</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
and দিয়ে দুইটা জিনিস যুক্ত → noun
Parallalism

questions.question:
You have no <u>right</u> to do waste water though you pay for it.
You have no <u>right</u> to do it.
You has done no <u>wrong</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
no (adj) + noun
(no right, no wrong)

questions.question:
The doctor is a friend of <u>mine</u>.
<u>Nothing</u> can ruin him.
<u>Some</u> are born genius.
<u>One</u> should do one's duty.
[]
questions.explanation:
Trick:
noun এর জায়গায় বসে → pronoun

questions.question: Neither of the two flowers has fragrance. Here 'neither' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
যদি neither একা দাঁড়িয়ে subject হয় → Pronoun
✔ যদি neither + noun হয় → Adjective

questions.question: <u>Everybody</u> hates a liar.[]
questions.explanation: Everybody / Someone / Nobody → indefinite pronoun
